title: Dynamic Regime-Aware Conformal Calibration for Reliable Economic Forecast Intervals under Multiple Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2608.17079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction provides distribution-free prediction intervals but relies on exchangeability, an assumption often violated in economic forecasting because of covariate shift, concept drift, local heterogeneity and latent regimes. We propose Dynamic Regime-Aware Conformal Prediction (DRACP), which combines density-ratio, localized kernel and probabilistic regime-aware weighting with a self-tuning online significance controller in a unified weighted conformal calibration framework. We distinguish three theoretical results: finite-sample validity under oracle importance weights, a coverage-gap bound for estimated weights with rates in effective sample size, and deterministic or regret guarantees for the online controller. We evaluate DRACP against six baselines on 48 real forecasting series covering euro-area and EU-27 HICP inflation, US macroeconomic and energy indicators, and daily financial series. translated_title: 动态机制感知的共形校准：多重分布漂移下可靠经济预测区间的实现
translated_abstract: 共形预测提供了无分布假设的预测区间，但其依赖于可交换性，这一假设在经济预测中常因协变量漂移、概念漂移、局部异质性和潜在机制而受到违背。我们提出了动态机制感知共形预测（DRACP），该方法在统一的加权共形校准框架中，结合了密度比、局部核和概率机制感知加权，并配以自调优的在线显著性控制器。我们区分了三个理论结果：在oracle重要性权重下的有限样本有效性、针对估计权重的覆盖缺口界限（以有效样本量为速率），以及在线控制器的确定性或遗憾保证。我们在48个真实预测序列上评估了DRACP与六个基线方法的性能，这些序列涵盖欧元区和EU-27的HICP通胀、美国宏观经济与能源指标，以及日频金融序列。近期在线方法（如FACI、stro...）也被纳入比较。
tldr: 本文提出了一种动态机制感知的加权共形预测框架，通过结合密度比、局部核和在线显著性控制，有效应对经济预测中的多重分布漂移，并提供有限样本有效性和覆盖保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dynamic regime-aware weighted conformal prediction framework that integrates density-ratio, localized kernel, and online significance control to handle multiple distribution shifts in economic forecasting, with finite-sample validity and coverage guarantees.
